rationale: The five new shifted-context conditions fail the declared advantage criterion. Extend the two fully observed matched shift pairs with the second registered fit: 16 retained episodes at 32768 labels and 256 episodes at 8192 labels, each under execution-law and presentation changes. These four predeclared conditions test fit sensitivity at short versus very long histories and allow nested-fit comparison to the corresponding native conditions. They do not create independent worlds or substitute discovery for confirmation. The remaining 256-episode/32768-label presentation counterpart is already admitted. No new model setting, criterion, lineage or extra occupancy seed is introduced.
